subject: Request: Latest penetration test for Hosted API + secure review channels
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@atlashealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: secops@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: latest pen test for Hosted API + recommended review channel

Hi Olga,

We are finalizing our procurement security checklist for Redwood and need the most recent penetration test report that covers the Hosted API environment (public endpoints + tenant isolation controls). Please also include any brief remediation status notes for high/critical findings and your preferred secure delivery options (we typically accept: time-limited S3 presigned link, secure document portal viewer, or controlled VDR access).

Two quick asks so we can close our checklist this week:
- Can you confirm the report covers the Hosted API production cluster (not just Dedicated)?
- Can you provide expected turnaround (or a link) for viewing the report securely — we prefer a read-only viewer or presigned access window.

If you need an executed NDA first, please point us to the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Jordan Meyers
Security Engineer | Atlas Health
jordan.meyers@atlashealth.com

--
Note: our compliance team is on a tight timeline for a go/no-go on Friday.
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@atlashealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test for Hosted API + recommended review channel

Hi Jordan — thanks for reaching out and for the timeline. Short answers up front: yes, the latest internal pen test includes coverage for our Hosted API production fleet (front-door endpoints, tenant routing layer, and key control planes). We can share a redacted PDF summary and provide time-limited, audit-logged access to the full report.

Sharing options we can offer immediately (pick one):
- Time-limited S3 presigned GET (48–72h window) with mandatory IP restriction and audit log export.
- Secure viewer link via our compliance portal (read-only, watermarked, session recording).
- Controlled VDR export for your legal/compliance team (download enabled, white-glove onboarding).

We typically redact customer-identifying data and contractor pen-tester PII before sharing. Ive attached a short high-level summary and an evidence manifest indicating what artifacts are available (screenshots, logs, fix PR references). If you require a non-redacted copy we will need an executed NDA; feel free to use your DocuSign link or we can send ours.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm preferred channel (S3 presigned / portal / VDR).
2) If S3 presigned, provide allowed IP range and preferred expiry.
3) If you need non-redacted, confirm NDA path.

We aim to get the presigned link or portal invite to you within 6 business hours once you confirm.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-1287

Attachments: redwood-pt-highlevel-summary.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@atlashealth.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test for Hosted API + recommended review channel

Jordan / Olga — quick technical notes from my side to set expectations on content and redaction.

Scope summary (whats included):
- External network blackbox against public Hosted API endpoints (authenticated and unauthenticated paths).
- Service mesh routing and tenant isolation checks in the production-like environment.
- Attack paths that require escalated privileges were verified against our latest IAM policies and runtime protections.

Redaction policy:
- We redact customer names, tenant IDs, and any PII from screenshots and logs.
- Vulnerability repro steps are retained but sanitized to avoid exposing live secrets.

Remediation status (high/critical):
- CVE-2026-0142: fixed in 2026-11-10 release; fix PR and internal ticket included in evidence manifest.
- Auth bypass (low 0-day style): mitigated via WAF policy and coordinated deploy 2026-12-01; residual findings are in backlog with ETA 2027-01-07.

Attachments included in outbound package: redwood-pt-highlevel-summary.pdf, redwood-evidence-manifest.csv.

Preferred secure flow (recommended for Atlas Health):
1) Execute NDA (if non-redacted needed). We can accept Atlas DocuSign or send ours.
2) We provision a portal viewer link (watermarked) for your secops account — this provides session logging and prevents downloads.
3) If you still need file access, we provide an IP-restricted presigned S3 URL for a 72-hour window.

If you confirm portal viewer, Ill spin up the record and share the audit link. If S3 presigned is mandatory, please reply with the IP list and preferred expiry.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-evidence-manifest.csv (CSV, 1KB)
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@atlashealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: secops@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test for Hosted API + recommended review channel

Thanks Olga and Vivek — appreciate the clear options and the summary. Atlas prefers the secure viewer (session logging + watermark) for initial review. We will request a presigned S3 only if our legal team requires a local copy after the review.

Next steps on our side:
- I'll route your portal link to our secops alias and confirm receipt.
- We can sign your NDA if needed; please send your DocuSign if you prefer that route.

Can you confirm the portal viewer will be available within 6 business hours once you provision it? If so well mark this item resolved in our checklist once we access and confirm the audit log.

Jordan Meyers
Security Engineer | Atlas Health

---
Preferred contact for logistics: secops@atlashealth.com
